newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson says wins Russia D-AMPS order.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson says wins Russia D-AMPS order.

text.p: Swedish telecommunications group AB LM Ericsson said on Friday it won a D-AMPS (Digital Advanced Mobile Phone Service) order from Russian company Bee Line Samara.
Ericsson will expand and digitalise Bee Line Samara's wireless communications network in Samara, the company said in a statement. It did not disclose the value of the order.
Bee Line Samara will change its system to digital D-AMPS so it can offer more customer services, it said.
Installation is due to begin in February. The upgrade will increase capacity to 7,000 subscribers from 2,000 by May 1997, Ericsson said.
Bee Line Samara is 50 percent owned by Russia's largest wireless communications operator, Moscow-based CIS Vimpelcom.
The other half is owned by local partners.
